items.html:
Hair Extensions for Curly Hair NYC

Can you get hair extensions for curly hair?

Yes. If you prefer wearing your natural curls most days, hair extensions for curly hair can add length and volume while still letting you enjoy your texture. The most important things to consider are how the extensions will blend with your curl pattern, how you style your hair day to day, and how you will manage your new growth while the extensions are installed.

At Luxe Aura Hair in Greenwich Village, Manhattan, every appointment starts with a consultation. Our specialists look at your curl pattern, density and styling routine before recommending a method, and our team does our best to match and install the most natural-looking extensions for your texture.

What hair extensions are best for curly hair?

Brazilian Knots Extensions are a favorite with our curly and natural hair clients. Strands are applied with a gentle stretchy thread, with no glue, beads or stressful sewing, and the method gives you the flexibility to heat style your curly new growth without the extensions falling off. Natural Beaded Wefts Extensions are another great option, especially if you like roller sets or drying your hair under a hooded dryer.

Tape-In Extensions, K-Tip Extensions and Microlink Extensions can also work well for curly hair, depending on your curl pattern and how often you straighten or blow dry your hair. The right hair extensions for curly hair depend on your texture, your styling routine and the result you want.

Can you style and color curly hair with extensions?

Yes. With Brazilian Knots Extensions and Natural Beaded Wefts Extensions, you can enjoy blowdries, roller sets and heat styling. Chemical services such as hair color, relaxers and highlights can also be processed while wearing these two methods, so you do not have to put your hair routine on hold.

How much do hair extensions for curly hair cost?

Avg costs start at $750+ and include Luxe Aura Hair Extensions Slavic human hair, installation, professional blending, styling, at home care instructions and continued support from our styling team. The final price depends on the method and the amount of hair needed. We are transparent about pricing during your consultation, so you will know exactly what to expect before your installation.

Why choose Luxe Aura Hair for curly hair?

All of our hair extensions use 100% human Slavic hair, and we carry over 80 colors in stock, so we can match your shade on the day of your appointment. Same-day consultations and installations are available. Our semi-private studio means your appointment is quiet, personal and unhurried, and your stylist will walk you through an aftercare routine for wearing extensions with your natural curls.

Contact us at (212) 221-3881 to schedule a consultation for hair extensions for curly hair nyc.

items.title: What are the best hair extensions for curly hair?
items.html: Brazilian Knots Extensions, Natural Beaded Wefts Extensions, Tape-In Extensions, K-Tip Extensions and Microlink Extensions are our most recommended options. The right one depends on your curl pattern, density and styling routine.

items.title: Can you heat style curly hair with extensions?
items.html: Yes. Brazilian Knots Extensions are designed for curly and natural hair clients who want to heat style their new growth without the extensions falling off. Natural Beaded Wefts Extensions also work well with blowdries and roller sets.

items.title: How much do hair extensions for curly hair cost in NYC?
items.html: Avg costs start at $750+ and include Luxe Aura Slavic human hair, installation, professional blending, styling, at home care instructions and continued support from our styling team. Your final price is confirmed at your consultation.

items.title: What happens during a consultation for hair extensions for curly hair?
items.html: Your stylist will examine your hair's length, density, texture and strength, and ask about your hair history and styling routine. They will then explain the methods suitable for your hair, the expected result, maintenance and pricing. Same-day installation is available.

items.title: How do you care for hair extensions on curly hair?
items.html: Use hydrating shampoos, conditioners and leave-in conditioners, and avoid alcohol-based products on your extensions. Keep up with your maintenance appointments so your new growth and natural curls stay healthy while you wear your extensions.
